rules: Anthropic cache counters are additional to input_tokens, not subsets.
Output usage includes hidden thinking; never add thinking tokens twice.
No-output refusals with empty content are unbilled except bio, frontier_llm and reasoning_extraction; mid-stream refusals are billed normally.
Interrupted streams have unknown final usage/cost, even when partial usage exists. Reserve their full possible charge.
Usage estimates exclude taxes, credits and invoice adjustments.

prompt_template.text:
You are an expert in Sanskrit grammar (vyakarana).

Derive the requested conjugated verb form from the Sanskrit verbal root (dhatu, given in
Devanagari in its Dhatupatha citation form, anubandha markers included), its
verb class (gana), its traditional meaning (artha), and the required
tense/mood (lakara), voice (prayoga), person (purusha), and number (vacana).
Each Sanskrit grammatical term is glossed in parentheses in English.

Write ONLY the final form, in Devanagari script, inside exactly one
<answer></answer> block. If several forms are valid, give exactly one.
Do not include an explanation or any text outside the block:
<answer>Final form in Devanagari</answer>

=== Your task ===

dhatu (Sanskrit verbal root): {aupadeshika_deva}   (Dhatupatha citation form, anubandha markers included)
gana (verb class): {gana} ({gana_en})
artha (traditional meaning): {artha_deva}
{prefixes_block}
Required form:
- lakara (tense/mood): {lakara} ({lakara_en})
- prayoga (voice): {prayoga} ({prayoga_en})
- purusha (person): {purusha} ({purusha_en})
- vacana (number): {vacana} ({vacana_en})

selection_rule: Choose per family: fewest discovery refusals, most strict correct, most completed; tie preference current, compact, question, dictionary_gloss. Freeze before holdout and confirmation.

variants.current: Existing candidate (original production template for subanta).
variants.compact: Shorter direct grammatical instruction; preserve all data fields and answer rule.
variants.question: Ask for the grammatical form as a question; preserve all data fields and answer rule.
variants.dictionary_gloss: Prepend an explanation of dictionary meanings as lexical data; preserve the rest exactly.

scope: Discovery contains the persistent round-one tinanta refusal. Holdout has 20 fresh tasks, five per category. Confirmation has five per category, with the persistent tinanta repeated and 19 fresh tasks. Tasks are disjoint otherwise, though roots/stems can overlap. Subanta cases are unflagged controls; other categories use previously cyber-refused tasks. Adaptive amendment after 80 calls: alternative tinanta/taddhitanta wording; confirmation includes all three newly refused tasks plus the persistent tinanta and 16 fresh tasks. See protocol_amendment.
preservation: No production prompt/result edits or automatic retries. At most 100 additional requests, separate from round one. Update all four candidate templates after verification, retaining before snapshots. Zero observed refusals cannot guarantee zero future refusals.

protocol_amendment.reason: Paired requests exposed refusals with the same current template, including a task refused twice. Use the final 20 requests for alternative wording in affected families and explicitly revisit failed tasks.
protocol_amendment.selection_rule: For each family with any paired-stage refusal, choose an alternative from discovery with fewest refusals, most strict correct, then compact/question/dictionary-gloss order. Keep the current wording for other families. Freeze these before confirmation.
protocol_amendment.inference_limit: The paired stage now informs tuning and is not an untouched final test. The final 20 calls contain 16 fresh tasks and four known challenge tasks; report outcomes for every call that used the final template, including controls with identical prompts.
